issues.where: rain streaks across the whole frame
issues.what: rain sits flat on top of the picture as uniform, ruler-straight white lines at a single angle with matching sharpness over both the foreground and the blurred skyline, ending in sharp points along the left soil ridge
issues.fix: place rain in 3D space with distance-dependent depth-of-field blur, varied streak lengths and opacity, atmospheric mist, and surface impact splashes

issues.where: water channel in the lower-center furrow
issues.what: the puddle surface has regular, metallic sinusoidal ripples and clips into the black soil banks as a flat plane with no wet shoreline transition
issues.fix: render muddy refractive water with finer rain-driven ripples, darkened wet banks, and a soft meniscus where water meets soil

issues.where: crop 1, top of the main stem between the upper leaves
issues.what: the stem terminates in a blunt, flat-cut smooth green cylinder with no apical bud or growing shoot tip
issues.fix: model a tight cluster of folded nascent leaves and hairy bud scales closing over the stem apex

issues.where: crops 1, 3, 4, and 5, undersides of the leaves
issues.what: veins on the leaf undersides are thick black lines painted onto a flat surface instead of raised, paler vascular ribs
issues.fix: displace primary and secondary veins on the undersides as raised lighter-green ridges with fine hairs

issues.where: crop 4, backlit leaves and lower cotyledons
issues.what: no light passes through thin leaf blades against the bright sky; upper leaf surfaces look blotchy and waxy, and the two lower cotyledons read as opaque black rubber paddles with a painted green centerline
issues.fix: add subsurface scattering and thin-walled translucency to leaves and cotyledons, and break up the waxy specular response with micro-roughness

issues.where: crops 1, 2, 4, and 6, hairs on the stem, petioles, and leaf margins
issues.what: plant hairs are thick, stiff, bright-white straight cones clumped in spiky tufts at nodes and leaf tips, turning into a pixelated white stippled halo along the lower stem edges
issues.fix: replace thick cone spikes with much finer, slightly curved translucent trichomes of varied length and density

issues.where: crop 6, water drops on the lower stem and crop 4, droplets near the right leaf tip
issues.what: water drops on the lower stem look like flat matte pale-green ovals stuck to the cylinder, while droplets on the right leaf read as hard metallic beads
issues.fix: render clear refractive droplets with sky reflections, curved contact menisci, and thin wet films on surrounding plant tissue

issues.where: crop 6, base of the stem at the soil and air above the left puddle edge
issues.what: the straight cylindrical stem clips directly into the soil with no root collar or contact shadow, and noisy grey stippled splash artifacts hover in mid-air to the left of the stem
issues.fix: add a slight basal flare, displaced soil collar, and ambient occlusion where the stem enters the dirt, and clean up unconverged splash particle noise

issues.where: crops 7, 8, and 9, grass tufts in the foreground and midground rows
issues.what: grass blades are knife-sharp, flat V-shaped cards in a single smooth green that clip straight into the mud and repeat as identical clumps along the midground field
issues.fix: give grass blades thickness, natural arch, ribbing, wet highlights, grounded bases, and varied clump shapes across the field

issues.where: crops 7 and 8, foreground soil mound and transition to the field behind
issues.what: the foreground-left mound looks like glossy stretched plastic dotted with smooth black pebbles and drops abruptly along a horizontal seam into a flat, featureless black field plane
issues.fix: extend granular, micro-displaced wet soil continuously across the foreground mound into the midground rows without a sharp detail boundary

issues.where: crop 1, sunlit inner margins of the two uppermost leaves
issues.what: the straight leaf edges show stair-stepped pixel aliasing against the sky
issues.fix: give the leaf margins slight thickness, subtle curl, and cleaner edge anti-aliasing
